# PdfAConformance

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

PDF/A archival-conformance level for the document.

Orthogonal to `AccessibilityMode` in storage, but the two interact: "a" (accessible) levels presuppose tagged output, so selecting `PdfA1a`, `PdfA2a`, or `PdfA3a` requires `DocumentSettings.Accessibility = AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`. The serializer enforces this at write time and throws a `PdfAConformanceException` if the combination is inconsistent.

"b" (basic) levels guarantee visual reproducibility only - they do not require structure tagging and so are the safe upgrade path for documents that have not yet adopted PDF/UA-1.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `None`: No PDF/A claim. Default. The document is a normal PDF.
- `PdfA1b`: PDF/A-1b (ISO 19005-1:2005, conformance B). Visual reproducibility against the PDF 1.4 feature set. Disallows transparency, JPEG2000, and embedded files. Retained for compatibility with legacy archival workflows whose checklists name "PDF/A-1b" specifically.
- `PdfA1a`: PDF/A-1a (ISO 19005-1:2005, conformance A). Adds the PDF/A-1b requirements plus tagged-PDF structure for accessibility. Requires `PdfUa1`.
- `PdfA2b`: PDF/A-2b (ISO 19005-2:2011, conformance B). Modernised visual reproducibility based on PDF 1.7 - allows transparency, JPEG2000, optional content (layers), and OpenType font embedding. The level `AsPdfA()` selects.
- `PdfA2a`: PDF/A-2a (ISO 19005-2:2011, conformance A). PDF/A-2b plus tagged structure for accessibility. Requires `PdfUa1`. Recommended for new archival workflows that also need to satisfy WCAG / EAA.
- `PdfA3b`: PDF/A-3b (ISO 19005-3:2012, conformance B). PDF/A-2b plus the ability to embed arbitrary file attachments - the basis for ZUGFeRD / Factur-X e-invoicing.
- `PdfA3a`: PDF/A-3a (ISO 19005-3:2012, conformance A). PDF/A-3b plus tagged structure. Requires `PdfUa1`.
- `PdfA4`: PDF/A-4 (ISO 19005-4:2020 baseline). PDF 2.0-based archival output. Drops the legacy a/b/u conformance split - there is a single PDF/A-4 baseline with no "a"/"b" suffix. Requires `Pdf20`; the serializer auto-upgrades the version when this value is selected. Attachments are dropped: PDF/A-4 accepts only embedded files that are themselves PDF/A. Use `PdfA4f` to carry them. The PDF/A-4e (engineering) profile is not implemented.
- `PdfA4f`: PDF/A-4f (ISO 19005-4:2020, conformance F). PDF/A-4 that carries attachments of any type. Requires `Pdf20`, which the serializer selects, and at least one attachment.
